capture.carrier: ME-2 cleaned_data static runs, 10 Hz decimated, 30 runs

physical_conditions.load_position: PL 0.25, PC 0.50, PR 0.75 of span (per row)
physical_conditions.note: Real load-cell samples. No packet, no cryptography. Twin residuals computed against the per-position calibration in the manifest.

parameters.sigma_source: ME-2 per-sample MAD of load-cell total, 0.0025 kg, rounded down (w03_baseline_summary.json)
parameters.twin: per-position linear: total_counts = a_pos + b_pos * load_kg, fitted on run medians, L00 runs shared
parameters.severity_note: severity is banded against the sensor-limited sigma (0.002 kg). severity_twin_linear is banded against the provisional linear twin residual (0.0144 kg), which is dominated by model misspecification (concave load response), not sensor noise. A better twin would move the second column toward the first.

integrity.note: No HMAC exists on this track.

known_limitations: Severity for scale and gain attacks depends on applied load; per-record severity is authoritative and L00 records are S0 by construction (zero-input invariance).
Only TEMP01 thermal condition. Twin has no temperature dependence.
Vibration off on every run. Combined load plus vibration (ME-2 Stage 4) not yet collected.
